Facultative. À chaque connexion, en plus: Optional. At each sign-in, on top of your password, you are asked for a 6-digit code: the one Google Authenticator shows on your phone (or a similar app: Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS, 1Password…). Someone who knew your password could not get in without your phone.
Dans Google Authenticator, touchez +, pu: In Google Authenticator, tap +, then “Scan a QR code” and point at this code. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows, to confirm.
Activée : à chaque connexion, le code de: On: at each sign-in, the code from your authenticator app is required. Lost your phone? One of your backup codes replaces it. To turn 2FA off: your password and a code.
Pas de scan possible ? Dans l'applicatio: Can't scan? In the app, choose “Enter a setup key”, then type this key:
A2F activée. Notez ces 8 codes de secour: 2FA is on. Write down these 8 backup codes and keep them somewhere safe: each one replaces the app code once, if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
A2F désactivée : le mot de passe suffit: 2FA is off: your password is enough to sign in again.
Entrez le code à 6 chiffres de votre app: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Code incorrect ou expiré : entrez le cod: Wrong or expired code: enter the code the app shows right now.
Code incorrect : vérifiez que l'heure de: Wrong code: check that your phone's clock is right, then enter the code shown right now.
Retirer la double authentification de {}: Remove two-factor authentication from {}? Their password will be enough to sign in again. Only do this if you are sure the request really comes from this person.
Seul un fondateur peut retirer l'A2F d'u: Only a founder can remove 2FA from an administrator.
